keyboard.description:
When focus is on the trigger, opens the color picker
When focus is on a trigger of a swatch, selects the color (and closes the color picker)
When focus is on the input or channel inputs, selects the color

When focus is on the color area, decreases the hue value of the color
When focus is on the channel sliders, decreases the value of the channel

When focus is on the color area, increases the hue value of the color
When focus is on the channel sliders, increases the value of the channel

When focus is on the color area, increases the saturation value of the color
When focus is on the channel sliders, increases the value of the channel

When focus is on the color area, decreases the saturation value of the color
When focus is on the channel sliders, decreases the value of the channel
Closes the color picker and moves focus to the trigger

dragging.description: Whether the color picker is being dragged

open.description: Whether the color picker is open

inline.description: Whether the color picker is rendered inline

value.description: The current color value (as a string)

valueAsString.description: The current color value (as a Color object)

isInSrgbGamut.description:
Whether the current color lies inside the sRGB gamut (linear RGB cube).
When `false`, wide-gamut CSS strings may still be valid while 8-bit RGB / hex are clamped.

setValue.description: Function to set the color value

getChannelValue.description: Function to set the color value

getChannelValueText.description: Function to get the formatted and localized value of a specific channel

setChannelValue.description: Function to set the color value of a specific channel

setFormat.description: Function to set the color format

alpha.description: The alpha value of the color

setAlpha.description: Function to set the color alpha

setOpen.description: Function to open or close the color picker

getRootState.description: Returns the state of the root

getTriggerState.description: Returns the state of the trigger

getContentState.description: Returns the state of the content

getGamutOverlay.description:
SVG path + label position for the sRGB gamut boundary (oklch/oklab + HSB area only); `null` when not shown.
Use the **same** `props` as

getGamutOverlayProps.description: Props for an `<svg>` gamut overlay; pair with

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the color picker. Useful for composition.

value.description: The controlled color value of the color picker

defaultValue.description:
The initial color value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the color value of the color picker.

disabled.description: Whether the color picker is disabled

readOnly.description: Whether the color picker is read-only

required.description: Whether the color picker is required

invalid.description: Whether the color picker is invalid

onValueChange.description: Handler that is called when the value changes, as the user drags.

onValueChangeEnd.description: Handler that is called when the user stops dragging.

onOpenChange.description: Handler that is called when the user opens or closes the color picker.

name.description: The name for the form input

positioning.description: The positioning options for the color picker

initialFocusEl.description: The initial focus element when the color picker is opened.

open.description: The controlled open state of the color picker

defaultOpen.description:
The initial open state of the color picker when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the color picker.

format.description: The controlled color format to use

defaultFormat.description:
The initial color format when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the color format of the color picker.

onFormatChange.description: Function called when the color format changes

closeOnSelect.description: Whether to close the color picker when a swatch is selected

openAutoFocus.description: Whether to auto focus the color picker when it is opened

inline.description: Whether to render the color picker inline

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

onPointerDownOutside.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

onFocusOutside.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

onInteractOutside.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

Trigger.data-side: The side of the trigger that the trigger is positioned on

Positioner.data-nested: Present when the positioner is nested within another {{widget}}
Positioner.data-has-nested: Present when the positioner has nested {{widget}}s

Content.data-side: The side of the trigger that the content is positioned on

ChannelSlider.data-channel: The color channel of the channelslider

ChannelSliderTrack.data-channel: The color channel of the channelslidertrack

ChannelSliderLabel.data-channel: The color channel of the channelsliderlabel

ChannelSliderValueText.data-channel: The color channel of the channelslidervaluetext

ChannelSliderThumb.data-channel: The color channel of the channelsliderthumb

ChannelInput.data-channel: The color channel of the channelinput
